requirements.text: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building production applications.
Strong backend engineering fundamentals, including API design, distributed systems, relational databases, and scalable backend architecture.
Experience building full-stack applications using React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.
Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including testing, debugging, performance optimization, and code quality.
Excellent product instincts with a passion for building user-facing software.
Comfortable working in fast-paced startup environments with evolving priorities.
Experience owning projects independently from concept through production deployment.
Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to product development.
Experience building or integrating LLM-powered features into production applications.
Background developing workflow systems, evaluation platforms, marketplaces, or productivity software.
Experience designing data models supporting AI-powered applications.
Familiarity with distributed systems and event-driven backend architectures.
Startup experience with significant product ownership and rapid iteration cycles.
Strong interest in AI infrastructure, machine learning applications, and developer productivity.
Experience working closely with product managers, researchers, and cross-functional engineering teams.
High ownership mindset with a passion for shipping impactful products quickly and reliably.
